Title: Azure Backup now supports network-restricted storage accounts

Body.Content:
Azure infrastructure as a service (IaaS) virtual machine backup now supports network-restricted storage accounts. 

Use storage firewalls and virtual networks to allow traffic only from selected virtual networks and subnets. This helps you create a secure network boundary for your unmanaged disks in storage accounts. You can also grant access to on-premises networks and other trusted internet traffic by using network rules based on IP address ranges.

With this announcement, you can perform scheduled and ad-hoc IaaS virtual machine backups and restores for virtual network-configured storage accounts.

For more information, see the full blog post.
